verdictBasis: All deterministic gates pass, every audited defect is fixed and regression-tested, and live CommandCode invocation was tested and passed (4/4, evidence at evidence/validation/live-smoke.txt). §36's PASS_WITH_LIMITATIONS condition -- deterministic tests passing while live compatibility remains unverified -- no longer holds. This PASS asserts that the specified gates were met and verified. It does NOT assert that the residual risks in knownLimitations are closed; those are documented and accepted, not resolved. The pre-audit PASS was unsupportable for the opposite reason: it rested on a live-smoke claim with no evidence artifact while a confirmed RCE was open.
coverageScope: all of src/ (1,892 previously-excluded lines now measured)
knownLimitations: Live smoke covers read-only invocation only (--plan); apply-mode and orchestration against a real model remain untested
Live costs are estimates; the provider returns no mechanically parseable usage
Capability-based eligibility (§17) is implemented and tested but inert: no catalog supplies capability data, and inventing it would violate §13

Recursion guard is environment-variable based and bypassable by a child that strips its own environment; the hook layer meant to back it up is unverified against the installed CLI (cmd --help documents no hooks)
Child cmd sessions retain their normal tool surface; ccroute cannot constrain what they do with repository text they read themselves
Optional direct xAI adapter (§33) not implemented; Grok remains reachable via cmd
Network deal refresh merges known model IDs only; unmapped page models are ignored rather than invented
Costs are estimates unless the provider returns usage mechanically
Secret redaction is pattern-based and cannot catch encoded, split, or unknown-format secrets
src/orchestration (83.95%) and src/cli.ts (86.55%) are below 90% lines; neither is a §35-named area
unsupportedAssumptions: Custom agents do not provide per-agent model fields
CommandCode hook event names, PreToolUse matcher value and deny-JSON contract are taken from documentation and are unverified against cmd v1.4.1
gitCommitNote: Points at the last commit containing validated CODE (3dc46c8). Documentation-only commits follow it and do not affect the tested artifact. A manifest or acceptance record cannot contain the hash of the commit that introduces it; the prior value was worse than stale — it pointed at an orphaned commit not reachable from HEAD.
liveSpendNote: Observed billing unavailable: the provider returns no mechanically parseable usage, and §19 forbids parsing model prose as usage evidence. Figures are ESTIMATED.
